title: Read working source hashes
responsibility: Snapshot tracked and nonignored untracked working files for later change comparison.

inputs.name: sourceSnapshot.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to list working source paths.

outputs.name: fileHash
outputs.description: SHA-256 for a regular file, link: plus target for a symbolic link, or null for missing/nonfile paths.

outputs.name: sourceSnapshot
outputs.description: Map of Git-listed paths to current file hashes or link markers, omitting paths with no file value.
